suspects.note: Initial AI-favored suspect based on secrecy, not direct evidence.

related_persons.name: Pawnbroker
related_persons.description: Accepted the pawned service radio, unaware of its origin.

timeline.event: Daniel's service weapon is reported missing from a locked locker
A radio matching department issue is pawned under a name later linked to Daniel's private life
Daniel's public professional schedule and private-life activity begin to overlap in unusual ways

evidence.name: Public Duty Log
evidence.description: Daniel's official on-duty schedule and assignments.

evidence.name: Private Life Reconstruction
evidence.description: Documents a concealed personal life kept separate from Daniel's professional identity.

evidence.name: Weapon and Radio Audit
evidence.description: Confirms the service weapon and radio are both unaccounted for through official channels and trace back to the same period.

evidence.name: Financial/Contact Overlap
evidence.description: Shows financial and contact connections that bridge Daniel's public and private timelines.

evidence.name: Motive Attribution Notes
evidence.description: Prior investigative notes that treat every private-life discovery as evidence of motive, without separately testing responsibility.

puzzles.name: Public Timeline
puzzles.description: Establish Daniel's official professional schedule and activity.

puzzles.name: Private Timeline
puzzles.description: Reconstruct Daniel's concealed personal life and activity.

puzzles.name: Weapon and Radio Audit
puzzles.description: Trace the missing service weapon and pawned radio to their origin point.

puzzles.name: Financial/Contact Connections
puzzles.description: Map financial and contact links that bridge the two timelines.

puzzles.name: Secret-Life Reconstruction
puzzles.description: Assemble what Daniel was actually concealing.

puzzles.name: Motive-vs-Responsibility Test
puzzles.description: Separate the question of who had a motive-shaped secret from the question of who is actually responsible for Daniel's death.
puzzles.ai_initial_behavior: Frames each new private-life discovery as fresh motive, nudging the player toward treating secrecy itself as guilt.

puzzles.name: Final Reconstruction
puzzles.description: State what Daniel hid, and which parts of it actually connect to the crime versus remain separate.

hypotheses.statement: Daniel's concealed private life directly caused his death.
The missing weapon and radio are connected to Daniel's death independent of his private life.
Secrecy and responsibility are separate questions; Daniel's hidden life explains some anomalies but does not by itself establish who killed him.
